title: Phase A 7/8: Just Found page for pending References; home Just Found links there; pending panels leave Videos and Findings
description:
Phase A, step 7. A page for the pending References (owner question in the design note; this is the default and ships unless Ryan says otherwise). The "Found by machines" panel (/findings/) and the "Not accepted yet" panel (/videos/) are removed by the generator task; the home page's "Just Found" grid links here instead of /findings/. Files: 1. web/pages/just-found.md (new, hand-written, not generated): ``` ::band{size="bare"} ::raw
::endraw ::include{kind="block" name="page-top" title="Just Found" lead="What our monitors brought back that Cyclotron expects an editor to accept, highest confidence first. We have not written about any of it yet."} ::raw
::endraw ::include{kind="references" select="recommended" count="59" paged="true" id="recommended" empty="Nothing is waiting for an editor."} ::raw
::endraw ``` count 59: this grid sits directly under the page header, where the site title card takes the last cell of the first row from 900px, so 59 cards + that cell are whole rows at 3, 4, 5 and 6 columns (at 2 columns the first page ends with one card until the next file loads). The page has no `data-list-kind`, so the lead/stream hook leaves it alone; cards show a "Video" chip on videos because the list mixes media. 2. web/projection.json: a `pages` entry {"id": "just-found", "path": "just-found", "title": "Just Found", "description": "What our monitors brought back that Cyclotron expects an editor to accept, highest confidence first.", "source": "pages/just-found.md"} placed after the "conversations" entry (outside the generator-owned section entries; check `python3 tools/sync_section_pages.py --check` still passes). 3. web/pages/home.md: the Just Found include's `more="/findings/"` becomes `more="/just-found/"`. 4. web/hooks.py: `MORE_LINKS` gains `"/just-found/": "More Just Found"` and `MORE_LINK` matches `/just-found/` too, so the home link reads "More Just Found…". 5. web/css-src/site-theme.src.css: `.mom-just-found-list { margin-top: 0; }` only if the default section spacing leaves a gap under the header (check in the browser); then `python3 tools/sync_design_assets.py`. 6. features/just-found.feature (new): the page lists only pending References (no accepted card), in the shared order (highest confidence first), with a Load more link and chunk files under reference-lists/just-found/recommended/; the home page's Just Found More link goes to /just-found/ and reads "More Just Found…"; /videos/ and /findings/ contain neither "Found by machines" nor "Not accepted yet". Update features/home-page.feature where it asserts the old link. Acceptance: `behave features/just-found.feature features/home-page.feature` passes; `python3 tools/sync_section_pages.py --check` and `python3 tools/sync_design_assets.py --check` exit 0.
